title: Robust Motion Generation using Part-level Reliable Data from Videos
abstract: arXiv:2512.12703v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Extracting human motion from large-scale web videos offers a scalable solution to the data scarcity issue in character animation. However, some human parts in many video frames cannot be seen due to off-screen captures or occlusions. It brings a dilemma: discarding the data missing any part limits scale and diversity, while retaining it compromises data quality and model performance.   To address this problem, we propose leveraging credible part-level data extracted from videos to enhance motion generation via a robust part-aware masked autoregression model. First, we decompose a human body into five parts and detect the parts clearly seen in a video frame as "credible". Second, the credible parts are encoded into latent tokens by our proposed part-aware variational autoencoder. translated_title: 利用视频中部分级可靠数据的鲁棒运动生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.12703v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：从大规模网络视频中提取人体运动，为角色动画中的数据稀缺问题提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。然而，由于屏幕外拍摄或遮挡，许多视频帧中的某些人体部分无法被看到。这带来了一个两难困境：丢弃任何部分缺失的数据会限制数据的规模和多样性，而保留这些数据则会降低数据质量和模型性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出利用从视频中提取的可靠部分级数据，通过一种鲁棒的部分感知掩码自回归模型来增强运动生成。首先，我们将人体分解为五个部分，并检测视频帧中清晰可见的部分作为“可信”部分。其次，通过我们提出的部分感知变分自编码器，将可信部分编码为潜在令牌。第三，我们提出一种鲁棒的部分级掩码生成模型，用于预测掩码的可信部分，同时忽略那些噪声部分。此外，我们进一步...（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种鲁棒的部分感知掩码自回归模型，利用视频中可靠的部分级人体数据生成运动，解决遮挡或缺失部分带来的数据质量与规模权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust part-aware masked autoregressive model that leverages reliable part-level human data from videos for motion generation, addressing the trade-off between data quality and scale caused by occlusions or missing parts.
